text.description: The words said. Variables go in braces ({first}); the engine fills them. Approved wording: the agent says exactly this and never composes its own.

interruptible.description: Whether the caller may talk over the line (barge-in). false for lines that must be heard whole, such as a keypad instruction or a legal statement.

mode.description: How the line is produced. fixed: the text above, word for word; the only mode there is for now (generated wording is not available). Default "fixed".

description: prompts.yaml: the lines the agent says, for one locale.
